'''Rayan Rupert''' (born 31 May 2004) is a French professional [[basketball]] player who last played for the [[New Zealand Breakers]] of the [[National Basketball League (Australia)|National Basketball League]] (NBL).

==Early life==
Rupert is a graduate of the INSEP Academy in France.<ref name=breakers-sign>{{cite web|url=https://nbl.com.au/news/french-phenom-rayan-rupert-the-latest-nbl-next-star|title=French Phenom Rayan Rupert the Latest NBL Next Star|work=NBL.com.au|date=10 June 2022|access-date=28 March 2023}}</ref>

==Professional career==
Between 2019 and 2021, Rupert played for [[Centre Fédéral de Basket-ball|Centre Fédéral]] in the French NM1.<ref name=australiabasket>{{cite web|url=https://basketball.australiabasket.com/player/Rayan-Rupert/505363|title=Rayan Rupert|work=australiabasket.com|access-date=28 March 2023|url-access=subscription}}</ref> He continued in the NM1 in the 2021–22 season with Pôle France.<ref name="australiabasket" />

On 10 June 2022, Rupert signed with the [[New Zealand Breakers]] for the [[2022–23 NBL season]] as part of the league's Next Stars program.<ref name="breakers-sign" /> The Breakers had previously seen fellow Frenchmen [[Hugo Besson]] and [[Ousmane Dieng]] selected in the [[2022 NBA draft]].

==Personal life==
Rupert's father, [[Thierry Rupert|Thierry]], was a EuroLeague player and captain of the French national team while his sister, [[Iliana Rupert|Iliana]], was the 12th overall pick in the [[2021 WNBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nzherald.co.nz/sport/basketball-new-zealand-breakers-sign-french-teenager-rayan-rupert/5LTVAKOEVSZ4IHOPY6QGIZAHUM/|title=Basketball: New Zealand Breakers sign French teenager Rayan Rupert|work=nzherald.co.nz|date=10 June 2022|access-date=28 March 2023}}</ref>
